$note: Measured coverage floors for the jsdom suite. Read by vitest.config.ts, which enforces them under `bun run test:coverage`; governed by scripts/check/coverage.mjs, which refuses a lowered one.
environment: vitest 4 + jsdom, @vitest/coverage-v8. Measures src/**/*.{ts,tsx} minus tests, barrels, generated token values, generated logo components and src/manifests/**. Barrels are excluded because a re-export-only module is covered by definition and dilutes the ratio until it stops meaning anything.

metrics.lines: Executed lines as a percentage of instrumentable lines.
metrics.statements: Executed statements. Lower than lines wherever a line holds several statements.
metrics.functions: Functions entered at least once. The most useful of the four here: an untouched function is usually an untested prop or an unreachable branch of a variant map.
metrics.branches: Conditional branches taken. Lowest of the four, and expected to be: every optional prop, every `??`, and every variant fallback is a branch.

policy: A ratchet, not a target. Each floor is the measurement below rounded down, minus about a point of slack for the noise a single skipped test creates. Floors may only rise: scripts/check/coverage.mjs fails a commit that lowers one, or that parks a floor more than 5 points under its measurement. There is deliberately no aspirational number here — a threshold nobody can meet is a threshold somebody deletes.
recording: `bun run test:coverage`, then copy the summary into `measured` and raise `thresholds` in the same commit. The suite must be green: coverage over a failing run is measured against tests that did not finish.

suite.caveat: Recorded on a fully green suite.

$rerecord: Re-recorded on a green suite. The first measurement was taken while 9 tests across 7 files were failing in concurrent work; v8 reports what executed, so a red suite under-reports every path those tests would have reached. All four metrics rose on re-measure (lines 87.16->88.29, statements 84.79->86.05, functions 81.01->82.44, branches 77.81->79.36) and the thresholds rose with them ({'lines': 86, 'statements': 83, 'functions': 79, 'branches': 76} -> {'lines': 87, 'statements': 85, 'functions': 81, 'branches': 78}), which the ratchet permits. Thresholds sit about a point under measurement so one skipped test does not fail the gate.
